verdict.rationale: Datadog's docs and APM/logs/dashboard pages plus community testimony (datadog-comm-3, datadog-comm-6) describe unified collection and correlation of metrics, traces, and logs via tagging, supporting the shared-context pivot story. However, another hands-on community account (datadog-comm-5) directly contradicts this, calling Datadog's cross-signal correlation 'awful compared to competitors like Honeycomb, Dynatrace and Instana' and criticizing reliance on outdated dashboards/notebooks rather than true unified context. Missing for 10: a definitive first-party walkthrough of cross-pivot (e.g., trace-to-log-to-metric linking) and independent benchmark resolving the conflicting community reports.
